id: \bRitchie: Hey there. Nice to meet you. Let's both do our best okay?
en: \bRitchie: Hey there. Nice to meet you. Let's both do our best okay?
it: \bRitchie: Ehi, ciao. Piacere di conoscerti. Diamo entrambi il massimo, ok?

id: \bRitchie: I can't believe how that went.
en: \bRitchie: I can't believe how that went.
it: \bRitchie: Non posso credere a com'è andata.

id: \bYou placed in the Top 16 this year. Come back next year to try again. Thank you for competing.
en: \bYou placed in the Top 16 this year. Come back next year to try again. Thank you for competing.
it: \bQuest'anno sei arrivato tra i primi 16. Torna l'anno prossimo per riprovarci. Grazie per aver partecipato.

id: \bOh you're \PN, are you not? Professor Oak himself was rooting for you. Why don't you go tell him how you did?
en: \bOh you're \PN, are you not? Professor Oak himself was rooting for you. Why don't you go tell him how you did?
it: \bOh, tu sei \PN, giusto? Il Professor Oak in persona faceva il tifo per te. Perché non vai a raccontargli com'è andata?

id: \bRitchie: Hey \PN. Nice that you didn't keep me waiting this time!
en: \bRitchie: Hey \PN. Nice that you didn't keep me waiting this time!
it: \bRitchie: Ehi \PN. Che bello che stavolta non mi hai fatto aspettare!

id: \bYour next match will be held in the Indigo Stadium again whenever you are ready.
en: \bYour next match will be held in the Indigo Stadium again whenever you are ready.
it: \bIl tuo prossimo incontro si terrà di nuovo allo Stadio Indaco, quando sarai pronto.

id: \rAww, I was hoping to face Ritchie again. But then again, you're the Monarch now.
en: \rAww, I was hoping to face Ritchie again. But then again, you're the Monarch now.
it: \rUff, speravo di affrontare di nuovo Ritchie. Ma d'altronde ora sei tu il Monarca.

id: \bYour next match will be a full battle, held in the Indigo Stadium again whenever you are ready.
en: \bYour next match will be a full battle, held in the Indigo Stadium again whenever you are ready.
it: \bIl tuo prossimo incontro sarà una lotta completa, e si terrà di nuovo allo Stadio Indaco, quando sarai pronto.

id: \bHarrison: Good to see you again. Let's see if I can beat you again, even if you're the Monarch now.
en: \bHarrison: Good to see you again. Let's see if I can beat you again, even if you're the Monarch now.
it: \bHarrison: Che piacere rivederti. Vediamo se riesco a batterti di nuovo, anche se ora sei il Monarca.

id: \bYou did good. Good luck with the finals.
en: \bYou did good. Good luck with the finals.
it: \bHai fatto un bel lavoro. Buona fortuna per la finale.

id: \bGary: Well \PN, looks like we finally get to battle it out in the finals, unlike our first time here.
en: \bGary: Well \PN, looks like we finally get to battle it out in the finals, unlike our first time here.
it: \bGary: Bene \PN, a quanto pare finalmente ce la vediamo in finale, a differenza della prima volta che siamo stati qui.

id: \bI had some time off from research and heard you were going to challenge the Indigo League again, so I thought, why not?
en: \bI had some time off from research and heard you were going to challenge the Indigo League again, so I thought, why not?
it: \bAvevo un po' di tempo libero dalla ricerca e ho sentito che avresti sfidato di nuovo la Lega Indaco, così ho pensato: perché no?

id: \bMay the best Trainer win, which will be me, of course. Even if you're now the Monarch!
en: \bMay the best Trainer win, which will be me, of course. Even if you're now the Monarch!
it: \bChe vinca l'Allenatore migliore, cioè io, ovviamente. Anche se ora sei il Monarca!

id: \bGary: Well played, \PN. You deserve this win.
en: \bGary: Well played, \PN. You deserve this win.
it: \bGary: Ben giocato, \PN. Ti meriti questa vittoria.
\bCongratulazioni per aver vinto la Lega Indaco!
